verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's hosted pricing documents on-demand billing with a configurable monthly spend cap, so overage from a spike is bounded and billed only for the extra events. Plans also carry event allotments, such as the Free plan's 1,000 events per month. Nothing shows quotas that can be capped per project; SDK trace sampling is a client-side setting, not a server-side cap, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: per-project event quota caps, documentation of what happens when the spend cap is reached, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the spend-cap behavior.
